name: Reduce wasmoon published output size while preserving runtime

description: Baseline: package tarball size from npm pack dry-run after build, with heapsort runtime guard and npm test checks
Disable JS sourcemap emission in rolldown; tiny tarball win so far because stale dist/index.js.map still remains in the package
Exclude dist/index.js.map from published files by making package.json files list explicit; large tarball reduction with no runtime code change
Tried enabling rolldown minify at the top level; output size was unchanged, so this appears ineffective for the current build
Tried rebuilding the WASM with -flto in the release emcc flags; it substantially increased glue.wasm size, so discard

Tried removing the unused HEAPU32 runtime export from the emscripten build; local glue.wasm rebuilds became much larger than the checked-in artifact, so wasm rebuild experiments are not comparable enough for this loop

name: Reduce wasmoon published output size while preserving runtime (post-wasm-rebuild baseline)

description: Rebased baseline after local wasm rebuild changed the checked-in artifact used by the package-size harness
Trim published declaration set to the files reachable from dist/index.d.ts, dropping unreferenced internal d.ts artifacts from the npm package
Enable TypeScript removeComments so published declaration files drop JSDoc/comment payload without changing runtime behavior
Use rolldown CLI minification during the release build; dist/index.js shrinks substantially with no correctness failures
Compact the CLI entrypoint source by removing comment/whitespace overhead and simplifying argument parsing without changing behavior
Tried extra rolldown minification flags (comments/legal-comments/internal-exports), but the CLI rejected the comments flag syntax
Tried adding rolldown legal-comments stripping and minify-internal-exports on top of CLI minify; output was slightly larger/no better
Stop publishing unreferenced internal type-extension declaration files (error/null/promise/table); keep only the declaration files reachable from the public API
Further compact the CLI entrypoint source with shorter local names and tighter control flow; package size improves again with checks still passing
Tried rolldown optimization.inline-const via CLI, but this rolldown version rejects that config path in CLI mode
Use prepack/postpack to publish a trimmed package.json that keeps only runtime metadata, removing dev-only manifest fields from the npm tarball
Tried swapping in a much shorter publish-time README via prepack/postpack; tarball got slightly larger, likely because the original README compresses well
Minify the publish-time package.json and drop the nonessential description field from the packed manifest for a further small tarball win
Trim the publish-time package.json one step further by removing the redundant license field and final newline from the packed manifest
Tried moving the CLI into a minified bundled dist/cli.js plus tiny bin wrapper, but the first TypeScript-based version failed to build due to import-attribute and typing issues
Bundle the CLI source into a minified dist/cli.js and replace bin/wasmoon with a tiny wrapper, shrinking the published CLI payload materially
Shorten the package.json files list with brace globs while keeping the same published file set, shaving a bit more manifest overhead
Tighten the tiny bin wrapper by removing the extra space in its import statement; microscopic but real package-size improvement
Tried removing the files field from the publish-time package.json, but npm then fell back to .gitignore-based packing and included far too much
Tried adding legal-comments stripping to both rolldown build steps; package size was unchanged
Shorten the package.json file globs again by collapsing the JS and WASM entries into a single dist/*.{js,wasm} pattern
Tried replacing the explicit declaration include list with dist/**/*.d.ts plus negated globs for internal declarations; package size got slightly worse
Build the CLI with its own rolldown config and inject the package version at bundle time, removing the runtime package.json import from dist/cli.js
Tried shortening the bundled CLI filename to dist/w.js, but without a clean build it caused extra JS artifacts to be packed and made the tarball worse
